author: sandmrk
text:
死手！！！

提示词，Muse Video Prompt — The Flame Ritual (text-to-video, 1 clip × ~10s)
Format lock: Aspect ratio 9:16 (source 720×1280, 30 fps) — the output MUST use exactly this 9:16 vertical ratio; no cropping, no reframing, no letterbox change.

Master (include with every clip):
Identity & costume lock: One young woman with a pale oval face, long straight black hair with bangs, deep-red lips, and — revealed only in Shot 2 — vivid red irises. She wears dark-fantasy silver armor dress: an iridescent metallic filigree breastplate with oil-slick rainbow sheen and red gem inlays, a high silver mandarin collar, fine chains with a pendant crossing her chest, long red-beaded earrings, and a dark ring on one finger. Semi-realistic CG render with fine 3D detail and cinematic skin shading, not live-action, not flat anime. Her face, hair and armor never change.
World & scenes: One scene only — a black void background with slow-floating spark dust in the air. No furniture, no scenery; the flame is the only light source that moves.
CAMERA — transcribed from the original: Shot 1 is an extreme close-up cropped at the chest — her face is OUT of frame above the nose, only her chin and lips enter at the top edge; Shot 2 reframes to her full face. Both shots are nearly locked, with at most a breath of slow push-in; the flame, not the camera, supplies the motion.
THE RHYTHM & FORCE: everything is slow except the fire. Her hands move at ritual speed — striking, lifting, offering — while the flame flickers, leaps and stretches at its own quick tempo. The flame must never go out, never become a candle or a lighter, and never burn her skin. If her hands start moving fast, or the fire turns into a steady lamp, it is wrong.
EMOTION ARC: concealment, then serenity, then revelation. While her face is hidden, the hands carry a calm, practiced confidence. In Shot 2 she first keeps her eyes closed, head bowed a degree, utterly still — then opens red eyes directly into the lens and holds the gaze, unblinking and unafraid, as the flame rises between her and the viewer. No smile at any point.
Lighting & grade: near-black shadows; the match flame is the practical key light, warm orange, lighting her chin, lips and later her whole face from low and to the side; the silver armor answers with cold iridescent highlights; fine golden spark dust drifts through the dark.
Music & sound: a dark, minimal ambient score — low strings and a distant bell-like tone, synthesized; the tiny crackle of the flame under it; no dialogue, no singing.

Clip 1 (source 0:00–0:07.1):
[0.0–3.4s] Shot 1 — Extreme close-up on her hands and chest, nearly locked: the frame holds her silver armor, her chained collar and her hands; her face stays out of frame. Her right hand raises a fingertip flame; she draws a small white matchbox into frame with the other hand and a fresh match flares bright against it — the brightest instant of the film — then the flame passes from fingertip to open palm to fingertip again, settling upright on her raised index finger beside her chin. Every move is slow and deliberate. Avoid: her full face entering the frame, the flame dying, a lighter or candle appearing, hurried hands.
[3.4–7.1s] Shot 2 — Full-face close-up, nearly locked (the framing opens to her whole face; her eyes are closed and her head bowed slightly, hands low and still): for a beat she is pure serenity in the dark. Then her eyes open — red irises — and lock onto the lens. Her hand rises, bringing the flame up until it stands tall at the center of the frame, directly in front of her face, and she gazes through its light straight at the viewer as the film ends. Avoid: eyes opening before the still beat, brown or dark irises, the gaze drifting off-camera, the flame covering her eyes, a smile.
Sound: the ambient score breathes under both shots; the flame's crackle is closest in Shot 2; no dialogue.
